{{Quote|Do you have a permit for that sidearm?|The bureaucrat to Roark Garnet|<ref name="RPG" />}}
A '''bureaucrat''' served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], stationed on a [[Unidentified planet (weapons restrictions)|planet]] with strict weapons control. The [[Bureaucrat/Legends|bureaucrat]] asked the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]], if he had a permit for his sidearm while on the planet. Garnet was unaware of the need for one, and inquired how to obtain one.<ref name="RPG" />
